[element-compound-subject-part]
=== `<compound-subject-part>` Compound Subject Part Name

Individual component of a multi-part subject (for example, subject term, code for the term).

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Attribute Best Practice

The <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>> attribute should be used to indicate the type of the various subject parts, for example, “`text`”, “`value`”, “`description`”, “`code`”, “`sponsor`”, “`taxonomy number`”, etc.

#### Related Elements

One <<element-compound-subject-part,`<compound-subject-part>`>> element is used to mark each component of a complex subject that is contained within a <<element-compound-subject,`<compound-subject>`>>.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>

  <compound-subject-part content-type="value">Nano structures</compound-subject-part>
 </compound-subject>

 <compound-subject>
  <compound-subject-part content-type="code">H01L21/02</compound-subject-part>
  <compound-subject-part content-type="value">Manufacture or treatment of 
   semiconductor devices or of parts thereof</compound-subject-part>
 </compound-subject>
</subj-group>
...
